streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream A contains substrate, catalyst, and solvent. Flow rate set to 0.5 mL/min to achieve target residence time with 5 mL reactor.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream B is gas phase oxidant. Flow rate calculated from Engineering Design Step 9 (5.34 sccm) to ensure sufficient O2 transfer.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Substrate and catalyst must be dissolved before gas introduction to ensure homogeneous photo-oxidation. T-mixer selected from inventory for gas-liquid mixing.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas acetonitrile is NOT required; reaction requires air/O2.
Pump Stream A (liquid) and Stream B (air) into T-mixer.
post_reactor_steps: Pass through BPR (5 bar) to maintain pressure and gas solubility.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of Fmoc-L-methionine using 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole. Gas-liquid flow design. BPR required for gas solubility. 420 nm LED used. Residence time set to 5 min (conservative vs calculated 0.3 min) to ensure conversion given mass transfer limitations (Da=230).

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculated tau=0.3 min, but mass transfer limited (Da=230). Analogy 2 used 12 min, Analogy 3 used 15 min. Selected 5 min as conservative compromise using 5 mL reactor at 0.5 mL/min to ensure conversion.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis for simplicity and consistency with MFC settings. In-channel time adjusted for pressure.

reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Design Step 8: BPR REQUIRED (3.0 bar). Inventory has 5 bar BPR. Selected 5 bar to ensure gas solubility and prevent degassing.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP selected from inventory for photochemical transparency (420 nm).
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: From Batch Protocol: 0.1 M. Maintained to match batch conditions.
